topic: Choose a new laptop model for the design team

scenario.topic: Choose a new laptop model for the design team
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to you when picking a laptop for our design work: raw power, portability, screen quality, or battery life?

options.name: Dell XPS 15 9500 with 4K OLED Display
options.upside: Outstanding screen quality ideal for color-accurate design
options.tradeoff: Heavier and shorter battery life compared to lighter models
options.concern: Some users report thermal throttling under heavy load
options.best_for: prioritizing visual fidelity and screen detail

options.name: Apple MacBook Pro 13-inch M2 Chip
options.upside: Excellent battery life and very portable for on-the-go work
options.tradeoff: Smaller screen and lower resolution than some Windows alternatives
options.concern: Limited ports may require adapters for peripherals
options.best_for: prioritizing portability and long battery life

options.name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Extreme Gen 4
options.upside: Strong GPU performance for rendering and multitasking
options.tradeoff: Slightly heavier with average battery life
options.concern: Keyboard layout may feel cramped for some users
options.best_for: prioritizing processing power and graphics capability

options.name: HP Spectre x360 14 Convertible Laptop
options.upside: Versatile 2-in-1 design with high-res touchscreen for sketching
options.tradeoff: Battery life less than MacBook but better than some competitors
options.concern: Convertible design may feel less durable over time
options.best_for: prioritizing flexibility and creative input options

shared_context: The design team has exactly 3 members involved in this decision
The budget cap for each laptop is $2000
The laptops must support professional design software smoothly

personas.name: Emeka
personas.background: As a lead designer focused on color accuracy, Emeka values the best possible screen fidelity for detailed visual work.
personas.private_goal: I want a laptop with outstanding screen quality that supports precise color work for our design projects.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
look for a workable compromise the group could accept
